# My Paris Pass

> > Official ticket booking platform for Paris and France attractions, offering discounted access to iconic landmarks, museums, and cultural sites.

My Paris Pass provides travelers with convenient online booking for major Paris attractions including the Eiffel Tower, Louvre Museum, Arc de Triomphe, and regional destinations like Mont Saint Michel. The platform specializes in offering discounted tickets and skip-the-line access to museums, monuments, and theme parks across Paris and France.

- Paris attractions and landmarks

- Museum tickets (Louvre, Musée d'Orsay, Musée de l'Orangerie)
- Discount ticket booking
- Arc de Triomphe
- Sainte Chapelle

- Montparnasse Tower
- Notre Dame Cathedral
- Catacombs of Paris
- Mont Saint Michel Abbey
- Palais Garnier Opera House
- Tourist passes and skip-the-line access
- France heritage sites and UNESCO attractions
- Theme parks and family attractions
